crm_at_risk@crm.active: When determining 'at risk', prioritize 'health' status 'R' (Red). For deals with 'health' status 'A' (Amber) or 'G' (Green), *always* call crm.get_notes to check for keywords like 'stalled', 'risk', 'delay', 'budget freeze', 'PO pending', 'no ETA'. Only mark a deal at-risk based on notes if crm.get_notes was explicitly called for that deal and returned relevant text. Do not infer notes. If a deal has 'Amber' health but no explicit risk in notes, it is NOT at risk. Ensure all owner IDs are resolved to names using crm.get_owner, and check their 'active' status, before including them in the final report.
